note: The four military services as employers: one company each, with no plants. `service` is the key stored in companies.service (shared/military.ts names the four) and `name` the company's name: a service is found by that name, in any letter case, and created when it is not stored. `slug`, `domain`, `description` and `headquarters` are set only where the stored company has none. Nothing here is a tag or a count: a career's tags are derived from its service and how many careers a service has is counted. scripts/build-military-sql.mjs turns this file into a migration (0062).
